ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in the Minnesota Medicaid program to identify potential fraud and abuse.
questions: How much money is involved in the Medicaid program?
What are the most common types of fraud and abuse?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions and budget of the Medicaid program, we can identify potential red flags and track the flow of money to uncover fraud and abuse.
